Questions you may have

01. Is APP Solutions only a mobile development company?

APP Solutions started as a mobile app development company, but currently provides a substantially broader spectrum of services. We have significant expertise in a broad variety of subjects, ranging from e-commerce to telemedicine. We passionately bring back-end and front-end web projects to life with composable architecture, Android, iOS, native, and cross-platform solutions to make customers feel happy. We offer top web and mobile application development and other services based on your needs, from prototyping your idea to polishing the final product through UI/UX design, front-end/back-end, infrastructure, EHR integration, and security. Our services also include AI/ML, design, cloud services, and data engineering. We can join from the idea stage to build your MVP or help you achieve predictable, agile delivery on your existing engineering roadmap.

02. What services does The APP Solutions cover as a mobile app development company?

APP Solutions provides mobile app development services for your chosen platform. Our outsourcing model allows us to assemble an efficient team of experts for project requirements of any complexity. No unnecessary roles — every team member’s contribution is planned down to the hour. We cover infrastructure, architecture, development, UI/UX design, testing, and ongoing support for as long as you need it. We select not just developers but professionals who can contribute exceptional ideas to improve and optimize your initial plan.

03. How does The APP Solutions choose app developers for a project?

Our company offers three interaction models, depending on your project’s stage and level of complexity. These include:

Time and Materials. A turnkey project model where you define the vision and goals for the product in the marketplace, and we handle the development.
Dedicated Team. A full software development team will provide you with all the technical aspects of the project while you focus on business and marketing tasks.
Extended Team (Outstaff). Ideal when you need a specific employee (e.g., cloud-native developer) without whom the product cannot be completed. We can select and support this person for the entire work period.

04. Do you provide health mobile app development services?

Yes, we do. We’re a leading web and mobile app development company with proven expertise in the medical field. You can find more details about our healthcare web development experience and other projects in our case studies.

05. Do your healthcare software development services comply with HIPAA standards?

Our healthcare software company complies with HIPAA and GDPR, which are regulations officially recognized in the US, Canada, and the EU. Additionally, we ensure the security of patient data through:

End-to-end encryption (both at rest and in transit)
Secure authentication and authorization
Data anonymization and minimization
SDL
Safe APIs
Regular security audits and penetration testing

06. How long does it take to develop an app?

If you want to develop a web or mobile app from scratch, you must understand that it is impossible to do so in 2-3 months. You should be prepared for the development process to take 6 months or longer. This includes planning, development, testing, launch, continuous improvement, and ongoing support of the newly created product.

07. How much does mobile app development cost?

The cost of the project depends on the following factors:

The number of specialists involved
Time frame
Scale and complexity of the solution (custom software development, MVP, or a full-fledged, comprehensive product)

08. How do you ensure app security and compliance?

Our team takes the following steps to maintain app security and compliance:

Regulatory Compliance. We strictly comply with data privacy and security regulations, such as HIPAA and GDPR, which are most important to e-commerce, FinTech, and a few more sectors.
Security-by-Design Philosophy. Security is incorporated into the development process right from the start, with safe coding practices and compliance requirements embedded into every workflow. These include handling sensitive data, encryption, real-time security monitoring, and managing user consent flows.
End-to-End Development. Services cover solution architecture, development, testing, and ongoing support.

09. Do you offer fixed-price or hourly billing?

We offer both. Fixed-price billing is ideal for standard projects with defined scope, schedule, and deliverables. Hourly billing (Time & Materials model) best suits projects with changing or undefined scopes, like app prototyping or continuous enhancements. The Time & Materials model charges based on the time devoted to the project and the cost of materials (effort) spent developing. For more details, contact us.

10. What technologies do you use to develop applications?

At APP Solutions, we use a wide range of modern technologies to develop scalable and secure applications customized to user needs, both mobile and web. These include React, Angular, Vue.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Flutter, React Native, AWS, Azure, GCP, AI/ML, and more.

11. What types of mobile applications do you create?

We develop a range of mobile apps for various industries and purposes, including:

Native mobile applications developed for Android and iOS.
Cross-platform mobile apps created with frameworks such as React Native and Flutter.
Enterprise Mobile Applications created for back-office business processes, employee management, and workflow automation.
Predictive analytics and personalization-enabled AI apps.
HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript-based Progressive Web Apps (PWAs).
